ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a park map with an irregular outer boundary, divided by curves into several regions. The regions are respectively labeled 12, 10, 11, 3, a central 4, 6, 7, a 9 on the right side, and another 4 at the lower right. It can be seen that the two regions labeled 4 are different regions: one is in the middle, and one is in the lower right. Reasoning: According to the alternating coloring method, take the first class as: left-side 12, top 11, central 4, lower-left 6, lower-right 4, right-side 9; take the second class as: 10, 3, 7. According to checking the figure, every shared internal boundary exactly separates a first-class and a second-class region; all outer boundary arcs belong to first-class regions, and point contact does not affect perimeter calculation. Since the number inside each region represents the perimeter of that region, when adding the perimeters of the first class and then subtracting the perimeters of the second class, the internal common boundaries cancel each other out, leaving only the outer perimeter of the park. Calculation: (12 + 11 + 4 + 6 + 4 + 9) - (10 + 3 + 7) = 46 - 20 = 26. Therefore the outer perimeter is 26 km.

Color the other class as the 10 region, the 3 region, and the 7 region. The visual check needed is that every shared internal boundary curve separates one region from the first class and one region from the second class, while all outer boundary arcs lie on regions in the first class; point contacts do not matter. 推理：按交替染色法，将第一类取为：左侧 12、顶部 11、中央 4、左下 6、右下 4、右侧 9；第二类取为：10、3、7。根据图形检查，每一条共享的内部边界都恰好分隔第一类和第二类区域；所有外边界弧都属于第一类区域，点接触不影响周长计算。由于每个区域内的数表示该区域周长，把第一类周长相加再减去第二类周长时，内部公共边界会相互抵消，只剩公园外周长。

计算：(12 + 11 + 4 + 6 + 4 + 9) - (10 + 3 + 7) = 46 - 20 = 26。因此外 perimeter 为 26 km。

method.method_draft: Use explicit edge accounting with two grouped perimeter sums. From the image, group the regions as A = {12, 11, central 4, 6, bottom-right 4, 9} and B = {10, 3, 7}. Let I be the total length of all internal boundary curves. The visual incidence shows that each internal curve is shared by exactly one A-region and one B-region. Also, the outer boundary belongs to A-regions only. Therefore the sum of the perimeters in group A equals outer perimeter + I, while the sum of the perimeters in group B equals I. Subtract: outer perimeter = sum(A)-sum(B) = (12+11+4+6+4+9)-(10+3+7)=26 km.

推理：设所有内部边界曲线的总长度为 I，公园外周长为 P。因为 A 组区域的周长总和包含外边界 P，并且还包含每条内部边界一次，所以 sum(A)=P+I。因为 B 组区域只由内部边界围成，且这些内部边界也都与 A 组共享，所以 sum(B)=I。因此 P=sum(A)-sum(B)。计算得 sum(A)=12+11+4+6+4+9=46，sum(B)=10+3+7=20，所以 P=46-20=26。
